mapper.sql: c.ID, c.COLLATERAL_NO, c.COLLATERAL_NAME, c.COLLATERAL_TYPE, c.COLLATERAL_CATEGORY, c.OWNER_ID, c.OWNER_TYPE, c.LOCATION, c.DESCRIPTION, c.ORIGINAL_VALUE, c.CURRENT_VALUE, c.CURRENCY, c.VALUATION_DATE, c.VALUATION_METHOD, c.VALUATION_AGENCY, c.VALUATION_REPORT_NO, c.PURCHASE_DATE, c.PURCHASE_PRICE, c.DEPRECIATION_METHOD, c.DEPRECIATION_RATE, c.RESIDUAL_VALUE, c.USEFUL_LIFE, c.COLLATERAL_STATUS, c.MORTGAGE_STATUS, c.PLEDGE_STATUS, c.INSURANCE_STATUS, c.INSURANCE_COMPANY, c.INSURANCE_POLICY_NO, c.INSURANCE_AMOUNT, c.INSURANCE_START_DATE, c.INSURANCE_END_DATE, c.CERTIFICATE_TYPE, c.CERTIFICATE_NO, c.CERTIFICATE_ISSUE_DATE, c.CERTIFICATE_EXPIRE_DATE, c.CERTIFICATE_AGENCY, c.REGISTRATION_STATUS, c.REGISTRATION_NO, c.REGISTRATION_DATE, c.REGISTRATION_AGENCY, c.RISK_LEVEL, c.RISK_ASSESSMENT, c.MAINTENANCE_COST, c.STORAGE_COST, c.MANAGEMENT_COST, c.REMARKS, c.CREATED_BY, c.CREATED_TIME, c.UPDATED_BY, c.UPDATED_TIME, c.ORGID

, CASE WHEN c.OWNER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' THEN comp.COMPANY_NAME WHEN c.OWNER_TYPE = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN staff.STAFF_NAME ELSE '' END AS OWNER_NAME, creator.STAFF_NAME AS CREATE_USER_NAME, COALESCE(usage.USED_AMOUNT, 0) AS USED_AMOUNT, COALESCE(c.CURRENT_VALUE - COALESCE(usage.USED_AMOUNT, 0), c.CURRENT_VALUE) AS AVAILABLE_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN c.CURRENT_VALUE > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(usage.USED_AMOUNT, 0) * 100 / c.CURRENT_VALUE, 2) ELSE 0 END AS USAGE_RATIO
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO c LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY comp ON c.OWNER_ID = comp.ID AND c.OWNER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF staff ON c.OWNER_ID = staff.ID AND c.OWNER_TYPE = 'INDIVIDUAL' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF creator ON c.CREATED_BY = creator.ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLATERAL_ID, SUM(USAGE_AMOUNT) AS USED_AMOUNT FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_USAGE WHERE USAGE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY COLLATERAL_ID ) usage ON c.ID = usage.COLLATERAL_ID
ORDER BY c.CREATED_TIME DESC

SELECT
FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO c LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY comp ON c.OWNER_ID = comp.ID AND c.OWNER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF staff ON c.OWNER_ID = staff.ID AND c.OWNER_TYPE = 'INDIVIDUAL' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF creator ON c.CREATED_BY = creator.ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLATERAL_ID, SUM(USAGE_AMOUNT) AS USED_AMOUNT FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_USAGE WHERE USAGE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY COLLATERAL_ID ) usage ON c.ID = usage.COLLATERAL_ID WHERE c.ID = #{id}

SELECT
FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO c LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY comp ON c.OWNER_ID = comp.ID AND c.OWNER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF staff ON c.OWNER_ID = staff.ID AND c.OWNER_TYPE = 'INDIVIDUAL' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF creator ON c.CREATED_BY = creator.ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLATERAL_ID, SUM(USAGE_AMOUNT) AS USED_AMOUNT FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_USAGE WHERE USAGE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY COLLATERAL_ID ) usage ON c.ID = usage.COLLATERAL_ID WHERE c.COLLATERAL_NO = #{collateralNo}

SELECT
FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO c LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY comp ON c.OWNER_ID = comp.ID AND c.OWNER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF staff ON c.OWNER_ID = staff.ID AND c.OWNER_TYPE = 'INDIVIDUAL' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF creator ON c.CREATED_BY = creator.ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLATERAL_ID, SUM(USAGE_AMOUNT) AS USED_AMOUNT FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_USAGE WHERE USAGE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY COLLATERAL_ID ) usage ON c.ID = usage.COLLATERAL_ID WHERE c.INSURANCE_STATUS = 'INSURED' AND c.INSURANCE_END_DATE BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + #{days} ORDER BY c.INSURANCE_END_DATE ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AVAILABLE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS = 'MORTGAGED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MORTGAGED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS = 'PLEDGED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PLEDGED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS = 'FROZEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FROZEN_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS = 'DISPOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DISPOSED_COUNT FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgid}

SELECT SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE) AS TOTAL_ORIGINAL_VALUE, SUM(CURRENT_VALUE) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_VALUE, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN CURRENT_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS AVAILABLE_VALUE, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS IN ('MORTGAGED', 'PLEDGED') THEN CURRENT_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS USED_VALUE, AVG(CURRENT_VALUE) AS AVG_VALUE FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgid}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO SET COLLATERAL_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO SET CURRENT_VALUE = #{currentValue}, VALUATION_DATE = #{valuationDate}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}

UPDATE TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO SET COLLATERAL_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CURRENT_VALUE) AS TOTAL_VALUE, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AVAILABLE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN COLLATERAL_STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN CURRENT_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS AVAILABLE_VALUE, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' OR RISK_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HIGH_RISK_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN INSURANCE_STATUS = 'EXPIRED' OR (INSURANCE_END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND INSURANCE_END_DATE < SYSDATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EXPIRED_INSURANCE_COUNT FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgid}

SELECT #{prefix} || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(COLLATERAL_NO, -4))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO WHERE COLLATERAL_NO LIKE #{prefix} || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '%'
